cards.card_text: Jesus says that at that time they will say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!" Then He adds, "For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?"
cards.verse_text: At that time ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’ For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”
